24def _make_handler(default_period: str):
25    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
26        def log_message(self, *_args):
27            pass  # quiet — we don't want a request log spewing in the terminal
28
29        def do_GET(self):
30            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
31
32            try:
33                if parsed.path == "/api/report":
34                    qs = parse_qs(parsed.query)
35                    period = (qs.get("period") or [default_period])[0]
36                    records = collect_all()
37                    report = build_report(records, parse_range(period))
38                    body = json.dumps(report_to_dict(report)).encode("utf-8")
39                    self._send(200, "application/json", body)
40                    return
41
42                if parsed.path == "/":
43                    self._send(200, "text/html; charset=utf-8", render_page().encode("utf-8"))
44                    return
45
46                self._send(404, "text/plain", b"not found")
47            except Exception as err:  # never let one bad request kill the server
48                self._send(500, "text/plain", f"error: {err}".encode("utf-8"))
49
50        def _send(self, code: int, ctype: str, body: bytes):
51            self.send_response(code)
52            self.send_header("Content-Type", ctype)
53            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
54            self.end_headers()
55            self.wfile.write(body)
56
57    return Handler
58
59
60def start_web(port: int, open_browser: bool, period: str) -> None:
61    handler = _make_handler(period)
62
63    # port 0 (or a taken port) -> let the OS pick a free one
64    try:
65        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), handler)
66    except OSError:
67        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), handler)
68
69    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
70    link = f"http://localhost:{actual_port}"
71    print(f"tokentab is running at {link}")
72    print("press ctrl-c to stop")
73
74    if open_browser:
75        threading.Timer(0.4, lambda: _safe_open(link)).start()
76
77    try:
78        server.serve_forever()
79    except KeyboardInterrupt:
80        print("\nstopped")
81        server.shutdown()
82
83
84def _safe_open(link: str) -> None:
85    try:
86        webbrowser.open(link)
87    except Exception:
88        pass  # opening a browser is a nicety, not a requirement

§ 02 · KEY FLOW

关键流程

disk logs → tolerant parser → UsageRecord → PricedRecord → grouped Report → CLI table / browser invoice

在 sources/tokentab/pyproject.toml:1 这一处，页面把源码证据和设计判断绑定起来；在 sources/tokentab/pyproject.toml:9 这一处，页面把源码证据和设计判断绑定起来；在 sources/tokentab/pyproject.toml:13 这一处，页面把源码证据和设计判断绑定起来；在 sources/tokentab/pyproject.toml:14 这一处，页面把源码证据和设计判断绑定起来；在 sources/tokentab/pyproject.toml:20 这一处，页面把源码证据和设计判断绑定起来。这条流程的优点是每层只承认一种输入形状；风险是入口文件一旦没有走到这个链路，底层解析器再干净也无法被用户正常调用。

§ 03 · EDGE

边界与失败

边界主要集中在日志格式漂移、模型价格表滞后、缓存 token 含义不一致和 provider 文件不可读。源码用 try_json、walk_files、provider try/except 和 unknown model warning 做了软失败处理；这适合本地观测工具，因为用户更需要“尽量给出已有数据”，而不是因为一个工具坏了让整份账单失败。
